listed_quote.quote: Prospect Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: PSEC ) ("Prospect") announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Patriot Capital Funding, Inc. (NASDAQ: PCAP ) ("Patriot").

announcement.quote: Prospect Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: PSEC ) ("Prospect") announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Patriot Capital Funding, Inc. (NASDAQ: PCAP ) ("Patriot").

outcome_evidence.quote: announced today that it has completed the acquisition of Patriot Capital Funding, Inc. ("Patriot") whereby Patriot merged with and into Prospect

deals.notes: Press release dated August 03, 2009 is attached to the 8-K filed 2009-08-05. Both on NASDAQ; the excerpts do not say in words that Patriot is a BDC, but the registration was on form N-14 8C. Patriot CIK does not appear in any FILING header.

announcement.quote: announced today that it has delivered a letter to the Board of Directors of Allied Capital Corporation ("Allied") in connection with its offer to acquire Allied.

outcome_evidence.quote: Accordingly, we have terminated our solicitation.

deals.notes: Unsolicited offer rejected by the Allied board, in competition with a proposed Allied-Ares combination; Prospect later raised its offer and filed a preliminary proxy in opposition to the Ares/Allied merger. Prospect ended its solicitation on 2010-03-05. The excerpts do not show Allied's listing. Whether the Ares combination completed is not stated in the excerpts.
